InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Read input: origen_144498.v · Open raw
module origen_144498 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    inout wire dht_data,
    output reg [7:0] temperature,
    output reg [7:0] humidity,
    output reg valid,
    output reg error
);

    localparam IDLE = 3'd0;
    localparam START = 3'd1;
    localparam RESPONSE = 3'd2;
    localparam RECEIVE = 3'd3;
    localparam PROCESS = 3'd4;

    reg [2:0] state;
    reg [5:0] bit_count;
    reg [39:0] data;
    reg [23:0] timer;
    reg dht_out;

    assign dht_data = dht_out ? 1'bz : 1'b0;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            bit_count <= 0;
            data <= 0;
            timer <= 0;
            dht_out <= 1'b1;
            temperature <= 8'h00;
            humidity <= 8'h00;
            valid <= 1'b0;
            error <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (timer == 24'd1_000_000) begin // 1 second delay
                        state <= START;
                        timer <= 0;
                        dht_out <= 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        timer <= timer + 1;
                    end
                end

                START: begin
                    if (timer == 24'd18_000) begin // 18ms low pulse
                        state <= RESPONSE;
                        timer <= 0;
                        dht_out <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        timer <= timer + 1;
                    end
                end

                RESPONSE: begin
                    if (!dht_data) begin
                        state <= RECEIVE;
                        timer <= 0;
                        bit_count <= 0;
                    end else if (timer == 24'd100_000) begin // 100us timeout
                        state <= IDLE;
                        error <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        timer <= timer + 1;
                    end
                end

                RECEIVE: begin
                    if (timer == 24'd50) begin // 50us
                        if (dht_data) begin
                            data <= {data[38:0], 1'b1};
                        end else begin
                            data <= {data[38:0], 1'b0};
                        end
                        bit_count <= bit_count + 1;
                        if (bit_count == 6'd39) begin
                            state <= PROCESS;
                        end
                        timer <= 0;
                    end else begin
                        timer <= timer + 1;
                    end
                end

                PROCESS: begin
                    if (data[7:0] == data[39:32] + data[31:24] + data[23:16] + data[15:8]) begin
                        humidity <= data[39:32];
                        temperature <= data[23:16];
                        valid <= 1'b1;
                        error <= 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        error <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    state <= IDLE;
                end

                default: state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
